title: Lesson 3: Managed Package vs Standard Runtime; Upgrades
description: Explain Managed Package Runtime vs. Standard Runtime, Automatic Upgrades, and Manual Intervention Upgrade.

questions.question: Which statement best describes Standard Runtime for OmniStudio components?
options: Components ship inside a managed package
Components are native metadata that ride platform releases and deploy via source format
questions.explanation: Standard Runtime treats components as native metadata; upgrades ride platform releases automatically.

questions.question: An upgrade 'requires manual intervention.' What does that mean?
options: The org upgrades itself with no action
Human review/actions (re-publish, validate) are required before the upgrade completes
questions.explanation: Manual-intervention upgrades need human steps before completion; automatic ones don't.

questions.question: A developer deploys OmniStudio components with `sf project deploy`. Which runtime does this imply?
questions.explanation: Source-format CLI deployment is the Standard Runtime pattern; packages use package installs.
